name: RollYearlyEvent
comment: event = Random(23)+1 (pop > 100000: 1/4 chance plague); each event has an extra roll, Karma (spell 10) makes bad ones rarer and good ones likelier; humans see dialog id 300+event. See docs/rules/events.md

name: Bankruptcy
comment: Sells buildings at the price table DS:5b10 until the debt is covered (dialog BANKPFANDDLG), fame -7

name: Report_Gossip
comment: Turn-start report, report_flags bit 0 (Klatsch und Tratsch)

name: UpdateBirthDeathRates
comment: surplus = grain_distributed/5 - population; birth/death rates from it, spell and event modifiers. See docs/rules/population-grain.md

name: UpdateHappiness
comment: happiness = 0.25 + fame*0.003 + asylum/3 + 2*birth + title*0.01 + units*0.005 + taverns*0.00025 - tax - justice - 1.5*death - pop/2.5e6 + modifiers; returns round(happiness*100)

name: IncomeFromBuildings
comment: markets*(77+R155) + mills*(165+R330) + taverns*(100+R200), * happiness, *1.25 with Bienenfleiss

name: GrainNeedMinMax
comment: needed = pop*5, min = needed*0.11, max = needed*1.06

name: UpdateInitiative
comment: initiative (+0x583) += fame/50 + 2, +1 with Feldmarschall; reset when header+0x14 is 0

name: LoseFame
comment: fame -= n (bankruptcy 7, finished palace part 10, cathedral part 20)

name: MaximizeTaxes
comment: Called each turn when maximize_taxes is set

name: Chance
comment: true with probability n percent (Random(100) < n)

name: Army1HasAbility
comment: true if a unit in army1 has the given ability (1-based, DS:53f1)
